requests.topic: Owned stamp list and stamp image contract
requests.reason: No stamp endpoint or response model is documented, so the My page cannot distinguish owned stamps or render their images without inventing backend behavior.
requests.requestedContract: Provide an authenticated owned-stamp list contract with a stable stamp ID, display name, acquired date, and either a frontend-readable image URL or documented photo identifier. Also define empty, unauthorized, and expired-image behavior.

requests.reason: Post list/detail responses expose photo IDs and instruct the client to resolve them through GET /photos/{photoId}, while that endpoint is documented as owner-only. Other authors' post photos would therefore be unreadable.
requests.requestedContract: Either include temporary readable photo URLs in post list/detail responses or document an authorization scope that allows signed-in users to resolve photos attached to visible posts. Preserve privacy for non-post and private photos.

requests.topic: Upload validation and signed PUT headers
requests.reason: Allowed image MIME types, maximum file size, and whether Content-Type participates in the presigned signature are not documented.
requests.requestedContract: Publish accepted MIME types, maximum bytes per file/request, and the exact headers the browser must send with the presigned PUT. Return a stable validation error for rejected files.

requests.reason: A photoKey can remain uploaded when metadata save, profile update, or post creation fails after the S3 PUT succeeds.
requests.requestedContract: Define automatic expiry/cleanup for unattached photo keys or provide an authenticated cancellation endpoint that is safe to retry.

requests.topic: Photo deletion and post photo editing
requests.reason: Deletion and replacement behavior is not documented.
requests.requestedContract: Document how profile and post photos are detached/deleted, including authorization, idempotency, and whether object storage deletion is immediate or deferred.
